notes.title: HOTFIX 6 and HOTFIX 5 Details
notes.content:
Hello,

This is a combination of Hotfix 5 and Hotfix 6 details.


Fixed water catcher stacking issue.
Fixed water catcher not generating water properly.
Increased electricity radius by 400%.
Added shotgun attachments (Cyber shotgun attachments not yet available).
Fixed spear durability after throwing and picking it up.
Added Grill to Tier 3 Crafting Table.
Increased Rifle Kit drop rate.
Increased Rifle Kit size.
All regular forest stones are now gatherable (except the smallest ones).
Minor Rocket Launcher fixes.
Minor Achievement fixes.
Researching items no longer destroys them.
Fixed Legendary Item List when researching.
Various balancing adjustments.
Improved AI pathfinding (still needs work).
Fixed multiple typos.
Fixed Woodshed and Firewood Block crafting with bare hands (still possible with any weapon).
Fixed vaulting in certain areas.
Fixed shotgun sound in Co-Op mode.
Added 4K resolution option to the Main Menu.
Fixed leaning and firing issue with pistols.
Fixed grappling hook material.
Replacing Cyberaugments no longer removes the old augment from inventory.
Fixed bug preventing the addition of the same augment to the last slot.
Fixed vehicle respawning bug.
Hotbar and inventory items no longer show an amount if only one is present.


These fixes may still have issues, but I have tested them multiple times.

Best regards,
Ville

notes.title: HOTFIX 5
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This update includes numerous bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements. Next, I’ll focus on adding new content while continuing to fix bugs, of course. There are many great ideas I want to implement to make base/cabin life even more enjoyable. Stay tuned!

notes.title: HOTFIX 4
notes.content:
This patch contains large amount of bug fixes and quality-of-life changes. Some picks:

[olist]
 Added the ability to burn sticks and wood in furnaces and campfires alongside firewood, though with lower efficiency.
 Renamed Berries to Radiated Berries.
 Improved AI navigation (still not perfect).
 Moved the suicide button to a new location.
 Improved backpack save system and implemented various fixes.
 Fixed issues with the watermill.
 Adjusted profession leveling mechanics.
 Reduced looting times and added custom enemy looting sounds for non-robot enemies.
 Adjusted enemy view range and increased bullet spread.
 Increased light radius for furnaces and campfires.
 Added many tooltips to assist players, including a cyberpsychosis warning.
 Implemented various story-related fixes.
 Removed combat blocking from buildings.
 Fixed major bugs related to weapon attachments and switching weapons.
 Made light optimizations for better performance.
 Buffed shotgun damage.
 Applied many other minor adjustments!
[/olist]

There are still some bugs and issues, but I am actively working on them based on your feedback from Discord and Discussions.

The next major fixes will focus on making AI logic more advanced and lifelike. I am also improving AI navigation and adding more variety to spawns, so expect many AI-related fixes and improvements!

Additionally, I am working on co-op bugs that occur when the host is in a different location than other players, which also affects AI enemies.

Thank you all! I'm glad to see you enjoying Raise Your Tribe.

Best regards,
Ville

notes.title: HOTFIX 3
notes.content:
Hello everyone, and a huge thanks to all of you. I recently posted the third hotfix.


Implemented shader precompilation at launch to reduce stuttering
Fixed multiple typos
Improved AI behavior and pathfinding
Player loot now appears in red with an increased shine radius
Fixed saving issues for Medium Farm and Water Catcher
Various building mode fixes
Optimized textures for better performance
Fixed multiple LOD (Level of Detail) issues
Increased player loot decomposition time
Major vehicle-related fixes
Improved co-op looting mechanics
Added split stack functionality for furnaces and loot
Fixed map opening bug during the starting fade
Fixed vehicles removing items during the starting fade
Fixed scope FOV issue when switching items
Improved UI for split stack functionality


One major bug reported by players is that when playing co-op and the host is on the other side of the map, the client may experience issues where AI enemies at locations like Trainyard don't detect collisions properly. I'm currently working on a solution for this.

notes.title: Small Hotfix 3
notes.content: Fixed couple little things! Next update contains more!

notes.title: HOTFIX 2
notes.content:
New Features & Improvements:


 Flip Car and Raise Bike feature added.
 Energy sources and usage added to tooltips.
 Structure rotation added for better placement.
 New settings options: shading, render distance, and foliage density.
 Solar panels now work only during daylight.
 Lamp lighting adjusted to be warmer.
 Lamp light distance increased from 700 to 900 units.
 Water catcher now fills based on rainfall intensity.
 AMD driver tip added to the main menu.
 More stones and metal ores to starting zones.
 Metal ore and stone shine distance increased 150%.

Bug Fixes & Adjustments:


 Fixed dropping stacks bug.
 Removing a furnace or chest now correctly returns stored items.
 Grass density on low settings increased from 0% to 0.2%.
 Fixed "TEXT BLOCK" issue on the main menu.
 Unreal Engine logo no longer appears randomly.
 Character leveling slowed down after level 10 for better balance.
 Profession progression adjusted for a smoother experience.
 Fixed Ghost and Baron profession progression issues.
 Fixed player clothing/gear stats reset bug.
 Enforcer Table renamed to Outlaw Table.
 Fixed Chemist Table icon.
 Windmill T2 can now be demolished.
 Correct demolition sound added for Firewood Block.
 Removing constructions now returns some materials.
 Several collision fixes.
 ARK rifle flashlight rotation fixed.
 Water catcher one bottle at beginning removed.
 Water catcher sound fixed.
 Melee spam bug fixed.



Currently, there are still known bugs, and I am continuing to work on them!
Some known bugs include:

When placing a furnace or any other placeable item, you can't open building mode ('G').
There are bad collision issues near the bridge.
Safe zone villagers have bad ragdoll physics.
And so on...


Best Regards,
Ville

notes.title: HOTFIX 1
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Here is a small hotfix.

[olist]
 Fixed graphical glitch caused by Virtual Textures
 Added a new AI enemy model
 Tweaked the AI system and reduced the range of Shooter AI
 Slowed down thirst depletion and adjusted thirst/hunger screen and audio notification frequency
 Made minor graphical adjustments
 Made minor performance adjustments
 Fixed Mutant AI hitbox issue after death
 Reduced Kukri drop rate from 5% to 1%
 Reduced Kukri damage
 Leather pants and shirt now require actual leather to craft
 Changed "Enforcer" profession name to "Outlaw" in the menu
 Lowered rain volume
 Made red-dot sight lens clearer
 Improved FPS limit settings
 Improved DLSS settings
 Radiation protection gear now properly affects poisoning
 Made several other small adjustments
 Added respawn-to-bed timer
 Removed building-blocked zones
[/olist]

I also adjusted the pricing of the game a little bit!

Best regards,
Ville

notes.title: Early Access Alpha Release TOMORROW
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

I’m excited to announce that Raise Your Tribe will officially release on March 6, 2025, after years of development and countless playtest events.

Tomorrow, I will be launching the game in Early Access with a 20% discount for the first week. The initial release will include Solo and Online Co-Op modes.

Following tomorrow’s patch, I will continue releasing hotfixes while also working on larger content updates and Official Dedicated Server support. Once Early Access is complete when official servers are running and the full content and story are released the game’s price will be updated to higher.

Thank you to everyone who has supported me on this journey!

- Ville

notes.title: Major Pre Alpha Patch 0.2 is here!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I’m excited to share some updates with you. Over the past few months, I’ve been hard at work addressing many of the issues you’ve brought up and implementing several fixes to improve the overall experience. In addition, I’ve added a variety of new and exciting features that I can’t wait for you to try out.

The next playtest is coming up soon, and I’m looking forward to seeing what you think of these changes. Your feedback, testing, and support have been incredibly valuable throughout this process, and I truly appreciate the time and effort you’ve contributed. It’s thanks to this amazing community that we’re able to keep improving and pushing things forward.

Stay tuned for more details about the playtest, and I hope to see you there!
